info.title: Authentication
info.description:
Obtain and use bearer tokens for the Batch API.

Authentication uses the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant. Credentials (`clientId` and `clientSecret`) are scoped per company.

All External API endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}`.

post.description:
Issues a bearer access token using the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant.

**Requirements:**
- `Content-Type: application/json` — enforced; returns `401` on mismatch.
- `Authorization: Basic base64(clientId:clientSecret)` header.
- Request body must contain `{"grant_type": "client_credentials"}`.

Tokens are UUID v4 strings. They expire after **1 hour**. There is no refresh token — re-authenticate to obtain a new one.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Set to `Basic` when credentials are invalid.

value.error_description: grant_type=client_credentials should be sent for this request
application/json Content-Type should be used for this request

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token obtained from `POST /oauth/token`. Pass as `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}`. Expires after 1 hour. A `401` with `{"error": "invalid_token"}` means the token is missing, expired, or not found.

expires_in.description: Lifetime in seconds, returned as a string. Always `"3600"` (1 hour).

OAuthError.description: Returned on token issuance failure and on protected endpoint auth failure.

error.description: `invalid_request`: malformed request. `invalid_client`: bad credentials or grant_type. `invalid_token`: bearer token expired or not found (returned by protected endpoints).

error_description.description: Human-readable detail. May be absent on unhandled exceptions.
